options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.off.sum: Disables anti-aliasing and upscaling. The independent Sharpness control can still be used, or left at 0% for an untouched vanilla image.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.fxaa.su: Uses a fast post-process edge filter. Use it when you want a lightweight smoothness boost with very little setup. Benefit: low performance cost and broad compatibility.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.msaa.su: Samples polygon edges multiple times while keeping cutout textures binary by default. Optional alpha-to-coverage can smooth foliage edges at the cost of possible distant fading.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.ssaa.su: Renders the scene above native resolution and downsamples it. Use it when you want brute-force image quality and have plenty of performance headroom. Benefit: excellent edge cleanup and very stable detail.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.smaa.su: Detects edge patterns and blends along them more carefully than FXAA. Use it when you want stronger smoothing without as much softness. Benefit: cleaner diagonals and better detail retention.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.taa.sum: Blends current and previous frames to calm shimmering over time. Use it when thin detail flickers or distant edges crawl during motion. Benefit: the steadiest image on moving scenes and fine geometry.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.nis_ups: Renders below native resolution and scales the scene back up. Use the independent Sharpness control to choose how much detail enhancement is applied afterward.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.dlss_su: Uses NVIDIA DLSS on Vulkan to reconstruct a native-resolution image from a lower internal render resolution. Requires external Streamline/DLSS files, a valid app ID, and supported RTX hardware.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.fsr2_su: Uses AMD FSR2 through the bundled native FidelityFX runtime on Vulkan to reconstruct a native-resolution image from a lower internal render resolution. Requires supported Vulkan hardware.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.fsr3_su: Uses AMD FSR3 super resolution through the bundled native FidelityFX runtime without frame generation. Requires supported Vulkan hardware.
Uses AMD FSR3 super resolution plus the native FidelityFX frame-generation path. Requires a supported Vulkan frame-generation swapchain context.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.mode.fsr1_up: Renders below native resolution and reconstructs the image with edge-aware scaling. Use it when you want a balanced performance boost with cleaner edges than plain upscaling. Benefit: better detail reconstruction at lower internal resolutions.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.sharpness.to: Controls sharpening independently from the selected anti-aliasing or upscale mode. 0% disables sharpening; higher values add crispness but can create halos or crunchy detail when pushed too far.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.msaa_samples: Sets how many samples MSAA uses on polygon edges. Higher values smooth edges better but cost more GPU time. The renderer may fall back to your GPU's maximum supported sample count.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.msaa_alpha_t: Optionally converts cutout texture alpha into MSAA sample coverage. This can smooth the edges of leaves, vines, and grass, but may make distant cutouts fade or stipple. Off keeps Minecraft's binary cutout behavior.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.ssaa_scale.t: Sets the render scale on each axis before downsampling. The 200% setting renders at 2x width and 2x height, which is conventional 4x SSAA. Higher values give a cleaner image but cost more performance.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.upscale_qual: Chooses the internal render scale for NIS Upscale and FSR1 Upscale. Quality stays closer to native resolution, while lower presets trade image fidelity for more FPS.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.nis_upscale_: Controls the render scale for NIS Upscale. Higher presets stay sharper, while lower presets push performance harder. Use it when you want to fine-tune the balance between FPS and clarity.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.fsr1_upscale: Controls the render scale for FSR1 Upscale. Higher presets stay closer to native quality, while lower presets favor speed.
options.salts_anti_aliasing.dlss_quality: Chooses the DLSS Super Resolution quality mode. Quality favors image detail, Performance favors FPS, and Auto lets the DLSS runtime pick from the output resolution.
Chooses the FSR2/FSR3 temporal upscaling scale. Native AA keeps the scene at native resolution, while lower presets trade image fidelity for more FPS.
